title: One source for every fact, and the globe draws change as patches
set_out: Make every document come from one source, finish the catalogue line by line, and keep the GitHub machines full.

sections.heading: What ran, and how each came out

entries.title: Each cell's change layer on the globe, with clustered losses (GRP-015, DEV-EACH-CELL-01 exploration 5)
entries.what: Clustered losses planted by the one command in four blood cells, read on each cell's own layer.
entries.outcome: A clustered loss lights its own cell's layer once loss times share is a few percent of the DNA; other cells' layers barely move.

entries.title: Sites held by one cell alone (GRP-015, DEV-EACH-CELL-01 exploration 7)
entries.what: A loss across a cell's whole pattern, read on identity sites and on sites specific to each cell.
entries.outcome: Specific sites do not place a whole-pattern loss on one cell; a joint reading of all cells is the next idea (plan 39.17).

entries.title: Met-A against the atlas: the second sealed test's synthetic run through the one command (GRP-014)
entries.what: 36 constructed monocyte arrays laid out like the declared list, each slide with its own offset, read and tared by the one command and scored by the sealed scorer.

entries.title: The flat picture and the globe count change the same way, and the globe draws changed blocks as patches (ATL-063)
entries.what: Blocks of 10 neighboring sites beyond the 5 % family-wise line on both; each changed block painted over its stretch of genome.

entries.title: The instrument catalogue corrected line by line at its sources; a status-claim check and a no-dates check in the push gate
entries.what: Every fix made in CANON/catalogue.json and CANON/instruments.json, which rebuild the page, the README table, the website and the book's toolbox chapter.

entries.title: One build command for every generated document (CANON/build_all.py)
entries.what: 28 generators in data-flow order, then the cross-document checks; the push gate runs it first.

open_at_turnover: Open: Group-A's reproduction through the one command (GRP-004); the plasma arrays (GRP-016); the firm-rate human timing sample (PHY-006); information sphere test 11 (ATL-046); each cell's healthy spread (GRP-015, exploration 8).
